name: Mont-Tremblant National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on eight summer trails and some campsites, May 1 to October 31; no dogs in winter.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on eight summer trails and some campsites, May 1 to October 31; no dogs in winter.

excerpts.quote: Prenez note que les chiens sont admis du 1er mai au 31 octobre.

dogRules.text: Summer trails: La Roche, La Corniche, La Coulée, La Piste-du-Loup, L’Envol, La Chute-aux-Rats, La Boucle-du-Lac-de-L’Assomption, Les Grandes-Vallées.
No dogs on the water or in boats.
No dogs in the park November 1 to April 30.
